from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Mapping


class ForbiddenLifecycleTransition(ValueError):
    """Raised when a lifecycle transition violates the canonical Slice-1 rules."""


class DocumentFormat(str, Enum):
    PDF = "pdf"
    DOCX = "docx"
    XLSX = "xlsx"
    PPTX = "pptx"

class DocumentState(str, Enum):

    PROCESSING = "processing"
    VALIDATION_READY = "validation_ready"
    EXCEPTION = "exception"
    VALIDATED = "validated"
    EXPORTED = "exported"


class ExtractedFieldState(str, Enum):
    PROPOSED = "proposed"
    CORRECTED = "corrected"
    ACCEPTED = "accepted"
    REJECTED = "rejected"


class TaskType(str, Enum):

    OPEN = "open"
    IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    EXCEPTION = "exception"


class NotificationChannel(str, Enum):
    DASHBOARD = "dashboard"
    EMAIL = "email"


class NotificationType(str, Enum):
    VALIDATION_READY = "validation_ready"
    EXCEPTION = "exception"
    EXPORT_READY = "export_ready"


class NotificationState(str, Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    SENT = "sent"
    FAILED = "failed"
    READ = "read"


class ExportJobState(str, Enum):
    REQUESTED = "requested"
    RUNNING = "running"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"


class AIQueryState(str, Enum):
    REQUESTED = "requested"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    DENIED = "denied"
    FAILED = "failed"


class AuditEventType(str, Enum):
    UPLOAD = "upload"
    PARSE = "parse"
    OCR = "ocr"
    CLASSIFY = "classify"
    CORRECT = "correct"
    VALIDATE = "validate"
    NOTIFY = "notify"
    SEARCH = "search"
    EXPORT = "export"
    AI_QUERY = "ai_query"
    EXCEPTION = "exception"


def enum_values(enum_type: type[Enum]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return tuple(member.value for member in enum_type)


def _normalize_state(value: str | Enum) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, Enum):
        return str(value.value)
    return str(value)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LifecycleContract:
    entity_name: str
    state_type: type[Enum]
    initial_states: frozenset[str]
    terminal_states: frozenset[str]
    allowed_transitions: Mapping[str, frozenset[str]]
    reserved_states: frozenset[str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)

    @property
    def states(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return enum_values(self.state_type)

    def can_transition(self, current: str | Enum, target: str | Enum) -> bool:
        current_value = _normalize_state(current)
        target_value = _normalize_state(target)

        if current_value not in self.states:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unknown current state {current_value!r} for {self.entity_name}",
            )
        if target_value not in self.states:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unknown target state {target_value!r} for {self.entity_name}",
            )

        if current_value == target_value:
            return True

        return target_value in self.allowed_transitions.get(current_value, frozenset())

    def forbidden_targets(self, current: str | Enum) -> frozenset[str]:
        current_value = _normalize_state(current)
        if current_value not in self.states:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unknown current state {current_value!r} for {self.entity_name}",
            )

        allowed = self.allowed_transitions.get(current_value, frozenset())
        return frozenset(
            state
            for state in self.states
            if state != current_value and state not in allowed
        )

    def require_transition(self, current: str | Enum, target: str | Enum) -> None:
        if self.can_transition(current, target):
            return

        current_value = _normalize_state(current)
        target_value = _normalize_state(target)

        if (
            target_value in self.reserved_states
            or current_value in self.reserved_states
        ):
            raise ForbiddenLifecycleTransition(
                f"{self.entity_name} state {target_value!r} is reserved in Slice-1; "
                f"{current_value!r} -> {target_value!r} is forbidden",
            )

        raise ForbiddenLifecycleTransition(
            f"{self.entity_name} transition {current_value!r} -> {target_value!r} "
            f"is forbidden; allowed targets from {current_value!r}: "
            f"{sorted(self.allowed_transitions.get(current_value, frozenset()))}",
        )


DOCUMENT_LIFECYCLE = LifecycleContract(
    entity_name="document",
    state_type=DocumentState,
    initial_states=frozenset({DocumentState.UPLOADED.value}),
    terminal_states=frozenset(
        {

    ),
    allowed_transitions={

        DocumentState.PROCESSING.value: frozenset(

                DocumentState.EXCEPTION.value,
            },
        ),
        DocumentState.VALIDATION_READY.value: frozenset({DocumentState.VALIDATED.value}),
        DocumentState.EXCEPTION.value: frozenset(),
        DocumentState.VALIDATED.value: frozenset(),
        DocumentState.EXPORTED.value: frozenset(),
    },
    reserved_states=frozenset({DocumentState.EXPORTED.value}),
)

def test_lifecycle_contracts_define_canonical_states_and_forbidden_transitions():
    assert contracts.SUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_FORMAT_VALUES == (
        "pdf",
        "docx",
        "xlsx",
        "pptx",
        "jpg",
        "png",
    )
    assert contracts.DOCUMENT_STATE_VALUES == (
        "uploaded",
        "processing",
        "validation_ready",
        "exception",
        "validated",
        "exported",
    )
    assert contracts.DOCUMENT_LIFECYCLE.initial_states == frozenset({"uploaded"})
    assert contracts.DOCUMENT_LIFECYCLE.reserved_states == frozenset({"exported"})

    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "document",
        contracts.DocumentState.UPLOADED,
        contracts.DocumentState.PROCESSING,
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "document",
        contracts.DocumentState.PROCESSING,
        contracts.DocumentState.VALIDATION_READY,
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "document",
        contracts.DocumentState.VALIDATION_READY,
        contracts.DocumentState.VALIDATED,
    )

    with pytest.raises(contracts.ForbiddenLifecycleTransition):
        contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
            "document",
            contracts.DocumentState.UPLOADED,
            contracts.DocumentState.VALIDATED,
        )
    with pytest.raises(contracts.ForbiddenLifecycleTransition, match="reserved in Slice-1"):
        contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
            "document",
            contracts.DocumentState.VALIDATED,
            contracts.DocumentState.EXPORTED,
        )

    assert contracts.EXTRACTED_FIELD_STATE_VALUES == (
        "proposed",
        "corrected",
        "accepted",
        "rejected",
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "extracted_field",
        contracts.ExtractedFieldState.PROPOSED,
        contracts.ExtractedFieldState.CORRECTED,
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "extracted_field",
        contracts.ExtractedFieldState.CORRECTED,
        contracts.ExtractedFieldState.ACCEPTED,
    )
    with pytest.raises(contracts.ForbiddenLifecycleTransition):
        contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
            "extracted_field",
            contracts.ExtractedFieldState.REJECTED,
            contracts.ExtractedFieldState.ACCEPTED,
        )

    assert contracts.TASK_STATE_VALUES == (
        "open",
        "in_progress",
        "completed",
        "exception",
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "task",
        contracts.TaskState.OPEN,
        contracts.TaskState.IN_PROGRESS,
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "task",
        contracts.TaskState.IN_PROGRESS,
        contracts.TaskState.COMPLETED,
    )
    with pytest.raises(contracts.ForbiddenLifecycleTransition):
        contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
            "task",
            contracts.TaskState.COMPLETED,
            contracts.TaskState.OPEN,
        )

    assert contracts.NOTIFICATION_STATE_VALUES == (
        "pending",
        "sent",
        "failed",
        "read",
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "notification",
        contracts.NotificationState.PENDING,
        contracts.NotificationState.SENT,
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "notification",
        contracts.NotificationState.SENT,
        contracts.NotificationState.READ,
    )
    with pytest.raises(contracts.ForbiddenLifecycleTransition):
        contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
            "notification",
            contracts.NotificationState.READ,
            contracts.NotificationState.PENDING,
        )

    assert contracts.EXPORT_JOB_STATE_VALUES == (
        "requested",
        "running",
        "completed",
        "failed",
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "export_job",
        contracts.ExportJobState.REQUESTED,
        contracts.ExportJobState.RUNNING,
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "export_job",
        contracts.ExportJobState.RUNNING,
        contracts.ExportJobState.COMPLETED,
    )
    with pytest.raises(contracts.ForbiddenLifecycleTransition):
        contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
            "export_job",
            contracts.ExportJobState.COMPLETED,
            contracts.ExportJobState.RUNNING,
        )

    assert contracts.AI_QUERY_STATE_VALUES == (
        "requested",
        "completed",
        "denied",
        "failed",
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "ai_query",
        contracts.AIQueryState.REQUESTED,
        contracts.AIQueryState.DENIED,
    )
    contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
        "ai_query",
        contracts.AIQueryState.REQUESTED,
        contracts.AIQueryState.COMPLETED,
    )
    with pytest.raises(contracts.ForbiddenLifecycleTransition):
        contracts.require_lifecycle_transition(
            "ai_query",
            contracts.AIQueryState.FAILED,
            contracts.AIQueryState.REQUESTED,
        )

    assert contracts.AUDIT_EVENT_INVARIANTS.immutable is True
    assert contracts.AUDIT_EVENT_INVARIANTS.actor_field_present is True
    assert contracts.AUDIT_EVENT_INVARIANTS.timestamp_required is True
